Subtracting 244 days from 1401-12-17.  
1401 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in the Julian calendar? Actually, Gregorian rules apply, but 1401 is pre-1582; we treat it proleptic Gregorian).  
1401 is not divisible by 4 → common year (365 days).  
244 days back from Dec 17:  
Go back 17 days to Dec 1 → 17 days subtracted, 227 left.  
Back through November (30 days) → 227-30=197 left, now at Nov 1.  
October (31) → 197-31=166 left, now at Oct 1.  
September (30) → 166-30=136 left, now at Sep 1.  
August (31) → 136-31=105 left, now at Aug 1.  
July (31) → 105-31=74 left, now at Jul 1.  
June (30) → 74-30=44 left, now at Jun 1.  
May (31) → 44-31=13 left, now at May 1.  
April (30) → need only go back 13 days into April: April 30 back 13 days = April 17.  

Check: From Apr 17 to May 1 is 14 days, not 13? Actually, Apr 17 to Apr 30 is 13 days (30-17=13). So May 1 minus 13 days = April 18? Let’s recalc carefully:  

We are at May 1 with 13 days left to subtract.  
Subtract 1 day → April 30 (12 left).  
Subtract 12 more days → April 18.  

Thus 244 days before 1401-12-17 is 1401-04-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1401-04-18
